topic: Stream API and Advanced Collection Processing
learningObjectives: Build stream pipelines using intermediate and terminal operations.
Apply filter, map, sorted, and reduce operations to collections.
Select appropriate stream operations for transforming and aggregating data.

activities.title: Stream Pipeline Map
activities.instruction: Explore the stages of a Java Stream pipeline.

content.concept: A stream pipeline consists of a source, zero or more intermediate operations, and a terminal operation. Intermediate operations transform or filter the stream, while the terminal operation produces a result or side effect.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Creates a stream from a collection, array, or another source.
Keeps elements that satisfy a predicate.
Transforms each element into another value.
Orders the stream elements according to the selected ordering.
A terminal operation that gathers stream results into a collection or other result.

activities.title: Stream Operation Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the stream operation that best solves each task.

content.concept: filter selects elements, map transforms elements, sorted orders elements, and reduce combines elements into a single accumulated result.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Keep only numbers greater than 50 → filter()
Order numbers from smallest to largest → sorted()
Calculate the total of all numbers → reduce()
config.answer: Keep only numbers greater than 50 → filter()

activities.title: Build the Stream Pipeline
activities.instruction: Compose a pipeline that keeps even numbers and converts them to squares.

content.concept: Stream operations can be chained into a declarative pipeline. Each intermediate operation receives the result of the previous stage, while the terminal operation completes the pipeline.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Pipeline Ordering
activities.instruction: Arrange the stream operations to transform the data correctly.

content.concept: The order of intermediate operations determines which data reaches later stages. For example, filtering before an expensive transformation can reduce the number of elements that must be transformed.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
